scope: Explicit local clean-worktree removal and recovery; disposable real Git fixtures and TUI approvals. No model performance score.
remote_native_ci: pending; frozen before 2026-11-01 Asia/Singapore; verify account restriction before resuming

source_seal.selection: All .py under src/sprig_agent, tests, scripts, plus pyproject.toml, uv.lock, config.schema.json, config.example.toml, AGENTS.md, MANIFEST.in
source_seal.algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({relative_posix_path: sha256(raw_working_file_bytes)}, sort_keys=True), default JSON separators and ensure_ascii=True. Raw files were shared with local WSL through /mnt/e. Documentation/report changes are outside the seal.

checks.wheel_main_module: not imported because it executes the CLI; --help exercised through extracted-wheel cli.main

raw_git_control.sprig_corresponding_test: test_ignored_local_data_is_not_removed; target and exact bytes retained

covered_behaviors: Detached unique commit retained in visible recovery branch, then restored through the existing approved create-worktree path
Original source index, staged/unstaged bytes, untracked file and HEAD preserved
Branch and packed branch references retained
Dirty, staged, untracked, ignored and extra empty-directory targets rejected
Hidden index flags, gitlink and symlink index modes rejected
Main/foreign/locked targets and configured private storage rejected
Fresh literal-True approval for each process; denial and cancellation preserve the checkout
Index flag mutation during status approval and same-size/same-timestamp edits during final approval rejected
Clean-only external filter not executed even when timestamp changes force Git to rehash
Recovery reference deletion during final approval stops removal and reports retained=false
Post-removal verification denial reports uncertainty without replay or cleanup
Inventory and process output budgets enforced
CLI/chat and TUI Enter/approval flows do not request a model or switch the conversation
development_findings: The unreleased first draft allowed an assume-unchanged flag set during status approval to hide an edit. The failing disposable test was corrected by freezing metadata before index/status inspection and rechecking it.

A clean-only filter was not discovered by the original checkout-oriented filter-name matcher. A timestamp-controlled test reproduced its execution; the matcher and removal overrides now disable clean filters too.
Other intermediate draft/fixture failures were repaired before the final frozen full suites. Earlier targeted results do not replace the final full-suite results above.
limits: Local WSL is not native remote Linux CI; skips are not passes
No force removal, automatic commit/stash/merge/push or deletion of recovery branches
No OS sandbox, exclusive checkout lock or filesystem transaction; external writers must be stopped before approval
Inventory is bounded to 20000 entries, depth 64, 128 MiB file bytes and 15 seconds per snapshot; metadata is bounded too
Recovery restores committed files, not private sessions, processes, pending approvals or previous acceptance conclusions
No proof of improved real-model repository success rate
